name: Midori Timer
description: A countdown in the status bar whose duration you type: 25m, 1h30, 90s or 1:30, in a small window a hotkey can open. Click the readout to pause or resume, right-click to extend or stop. Counts against an absolute deadline rather than decrementing a number, so it stays accurate while the window is in the background or the machine sleeps, and survives a restart. The readout uses tabular figures and reserves its width so the status bar never reflows. Desktop only for the widget, since Obsidian hides the status bar on phones; the commands work everywhere.
author: Benjamin Loschen
